uq_hiring_run_active.name: uq_hiring_run_active
uq_hiring_run_active.where: status = 'IN_PROGRESS' and job_id is not null

uq_imported_job_public_url.name: uq_imported_job_public_url
uq_imported_job_public_url.where: visibility = 'PUBLIC' and url_hash is not null

uq_imported_job_private_owner_url.name: uq_imported_job_private_owner_url
uq_imported_job_private_owner_url.where: visibility = 'PRIVATE' and url_hash is not null and status <> 'FAILED'

chk_interview_report_company.name: chk_interview_report_company
chk_interview_report_company.value: "interview_report"."company_id" is not null or "interview_report"."company_request_id" is not null

chk_referral_request_job.name: chk_referral_request_job
chk_referral_request_job.value: "referral_request"."job_id" is not null or "referral_request"."imported_job_id" is not null
